From: Samuel Perez <sam.perez@secureaudit.com>

Cc: Katherine Li <katherine.li@arcadia.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arcadia SDLC evidence ask: deploy approvals + secrets rotation history

Jonas —

Thanks for taking this on. Arcadia's QS team has a couple of targeted asks for our SIG/SOC2 review: can you provide evidence for the last 12 months showing:

- code review enforcement (PR gating policy + representative PRs across services)
- CI/CD controls (pipeline mutability, who can edit, signed commits)
- secrets management (ephemeral credentials, KMS/HSM usage, rotation cadence)
- change approvals and emergency patch process (audit trail, rollbacks)

A few specifics we need: a manifest listing files you'd like to include, a sample of pipeline logs (sanitized), and the change-approval records for two recent deploys (one normal, one emergency). If you can bundle as attachments or share a Drive link that works.

Also please indicate any known gaps or compensating controls — the assessor will flag deviations early. Can we get an initial package by EOD Thursday (6/17)?

Appreciate it — Sam

--
Samuel Perez
Senior Assessor, SecureAudit
sam.perez@secureaudit.com

Subject: Re: Arcadia SDLC evidence ask: deploy approvals + secrets rotation history

Sam / Katherine —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a focused package and flag anything that requires redaction. Quick plan:

1) Manifest + index PDF (matches file list you asked for) — attached.
2) CI pipeline logs tarball: sanitized build IDs + timestamps for the requested 12-month window — attaching a sample for May 2027; full bundle available via Drive link.
3) Code review extracts: three representative PRs across runtime, control-plane, and infra repos with gating metadata (approver, required checks, merge timestamp) — attached as zip.
4) Change approval matrix: csv exported from our change-management tool plus two deploy approval threads (one routine, one emergency) as message exports.

Notes / known gaps: we still have a small number of legacy infra jobs (pre-2026) that lack signed commits; compensating control is mandatory pipeline inspection and artifact verification for those specific jobs. We'll call that out in the manifest.

Target: deliver attachments + Drive links by EOD Thu (6/17). Irene will own the artifacts; copying her to coordinate redactions. Marissa will pull the two deploy traces.

Next steps: Irene — can you confirm the sanitized pipeline sample is ready for Thursday? Marissa — can you export the two approval threads and send to me by Wednesday noon?

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Head of Security & Compliance (acting)
